item_10_recommendation.reason: A PRODUCT-COLD-START-LIVENESS component is CONFIRMED, which mandates DR-CS-2 and forbids making v3.2 pass. No single change reaches the 0.90 bar; only a cumulative stack does, and two of its components are forbidden. PATH-A would narrow the product claim away from the BLOS regime without fixing either product defect.

item_2_estimator_product_path.missing: wiring + one ordinal counter, NOT measurement

evidence.interpretation: Every stalled run was offered all 384 units (app_enqueued=384 ⇒ NOT a harness feeding failure), emitted only the handful the PreConverge floor allows, received zero ACKs, and fired ZERO §3.3-B geometric copies and ZERO tail probes despite millions of probe-due decisions — i.e. both product cold-start recovery mechanisms were token-starved.

extended_timeout_derivation.guard_justification: guard = RTT (one full round trip for the first SACK to return) + PreConverge emission quantum (ceil(SEALED / PRE_CONVERGE_FLOOR_BW) = time to accrue tokens for ONE 101 B unit at the 31 B/s floor) + harness timer resolution dt (10 µs), rounded UP to a whole second. Both terms are required: a sender that has just emitted its first unit needs a further RTT before any SACK can possibly arrive, and it cannot emit at all faster than the floor quantum.

floor_pacing.formula: tx_data ≈ floor(budget_s × PRE_CONVERGE_FLOOR_BW(31 B/s) / SEALED(101 B))

item_5_root_cause.second_pathology: post-convergence rate-ramp lock (D2 rep2: 288 B/s vs 27525 B/s healthy; rep31)
item_5_root_cause.statement: MIXED, with a CONFIRMED PRODUCT-COLD-START-LIVENESS component. A subset of runs recovers only AFTER the frozen 18.498 s budget (HARNESS-TIME-BUDGET), but another subset never leaves PreConverge even at the authoritative extended bound (65 s > CS_GIVEUP 60 s) while the harness drives every product path and offers all 384 units. HARNESS-DRIVER is REFUTED by app_enqueued=384 on every stalled run.

Q1_telemetry_never_produced.answer: These runs have NO telemetry at all (zero ACK batches, srtt never set). Their telemetry_stale=true is produced by the harness zero-initialisation of last_ack_progress_ns, not by an aged measurement.

Q3_single_input_or_combined_snapshot.harness: SINGLE input: now − last ACK ARRIVAL (fs_cal2_spine.rs, one assignment site).
Q3_single_input_or_combined_snapshot.product: UNDETERMINED. FusionObservation::telemetry_age_ns has NO producer anywhere in the repo outside a #[cfg(test)] fixture; the doc says 'newest telemetry update feeding inputs' over 5 heterogeneous signals, which is a MIN-over-ages (permissive) reading, but no code implements it.
Q3_single_input_or_combined_snapshot.verdict: The threshold (2 s) is grounded; the OPERAND is not. Harness staleness is a proxy, NOT a faithful reproduction of a product definition.

Q4_freshness_refresh_after_corrections.answer: NO. last_ack_progress_ns is refreshed ONLY on a non-empty ACK batch. Late-ACK and spurious-loss corrections in the estimator do NOT refresh it. It is also refreshed by parity/retransmit ACKs, and it performs no inflight-shrink progress test despite its name — the genuine product analogue (TailRecovery::last_progress_ns, gated on inflight shrink) exists but is not publicly readable and is not used.

Q5_burst_localised_or_whole_rtt1000.note: Staleness at RTT=1000 ms splits into two DISTINCT populations, not one gradient.
